name: Avatars Minecraft
author: MineLabz

sections.description: Avatars for Minecraft replaces the WP Comment avatars with Minecraft avatars. By utilizing the heads directory, Avatars for Minecraft can securely retrieve heads information and replace any gravatar image with a Minecraft head one. In order for this to work, a name must have an existing skin associated with it. If the name cannot be retrieved from the heads library, the default Steve head will be displayed.
sections.faq:
Do we need extra plugins to run Avatars for Minecraft?

No, the plugin is standalone, and does not require installation of extra plugins in order to work.

From where are the heads retrieved?

Each head is retrived from https://minotar.net, by utilizing the Minotar API.
